games.name: Fortnite Mobile
games.gameplay: Jump from the Battle Bus, grab loot, build like an architect on energy drinks, and survive the storm to flex that Victory Royale crown 👑. From concerts to wild crossovers, Fortnite is half game, half festival 🎶🔥.

games.name: Apex Legends Mobile
games.gameplay: Drop with a squad, master unique Legends, slide into fights like a pro, and outplay enemies with pure skill and teamwork 🧠🔫. No building — just brains, bullets, and clutch moments.

faqs.question: Which game is easier for beginners?
faqs.answer: Fortnite Mobile is more beginner-friendly thanks to casual modes and creative fun 🎨.

faqs.question: Which game is better for competitive players?
faqs.answer: Apex Legends Mobile shines with tactical gameplay and ranked focus 🧠.

faqs.question: Do both games cost money?
faqs.answer: Nope! Both are free-to-play, your wallet is safe 💸.

faqs.question: Which game feels more intense?
faqs.answer: Apex Legends Mobile feels faster and sweatier, Fortnite feels crazier and fun 😄.
